title: Agreement Type and Purpose
prompt: Match each agreement type to its primary purpose.

pairs.right: Bind the vendor to measurable service levels
Define the quantified service performance target
Establish the general terms of the contractual relationship
Describe a specific engagement, its deliverables, and timeline
Scope and authorize a penetration test

explain: SLA/SLO govern performance, NDA governs confidentiality, MOU/MOA govern the level of commitment, MSA/SOW govern the framework and specific work, and ROE govern authorization for testing.
